statement: Let f : X → Y be a surjective morphism with connected fibers between smooth connected projective complex varieties. Let DX, DY be reduced effective simple normal crossing divisors, allowing zero boundaries, such that Supp(f∗ DY ) ⊆ Supp(DX). For a very general smooth fiber F, put DF = DX|F . Then κ(X, KX + DX) ≥ κ(F, KF + DF ) + κ(Y, KY + DY ). Here DF is reduced with simple normal crossings and KF + DF ∼ (KX + DX)|F . The convention (−∞) + b = −∞ applies also when b = −∞, and the zero divisor on a point has Iitaka dimension zero.
